content.title: Believe in Jesus Christ
content.text: Chuck Norris has passed away at 86. He was known around the world for his strength, toughness, and discipline—but masculinity to Chuck could be summed up in his own words: “Real men love Jesus.” In an industry that often pressures people to stay silent about their faith, he consistently used his platform to point people toward Jesus Christ.He often spoke about the transformation that comes through a personal relationship with Jesus. “Jesus Christ is the only way to heaven,” he said, and he emphasized that faith isn’t about religion, but about a real, personal relationship with God. He said, “It's important to make your peace with Christ while the opportunity exists. Life is so fragile. You never know when it's going to be over. It could be over in a blink of an eye, and then it's too late to accept God's gift of salvation.” Those words hit home on a day like today, and Chuck is finally on the arms of his Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Chuck and his wife Gena were married for 28 years, and he had 5 kids and 13 grandkids. Even with Hollywood fame and success, he always made time for his family. What made his Christian witness so powerful was that it reached people who might never step foot in a church. Through interviews, writing, and public appearances, he consistently redirected attention back to Jesus. He said, “We are all human. We all fall short. But through Christ, we can find forgiveness and a new beginning.” His life echoed the message that following Christ isn’t weakness—it’s the greatest act of masculine strength and courage a person can ever make!
